This single family office investor has been deploying capital globally since the 1980s, and his latest thesis centers on the fastest-growing, least-competed region in the world: emerging African markets. 4HngF5KZ7bU.description:

In this segment from BBC Focus on Africa, we dive into the critical challenges facing the continent’s development. Currently, Africa receives just 5% of global infrastructure investment, a disparity that translates into daily hurdles for young Africans—from frequent power outages to limited internet connectivity.
